original_text:
🎉 Fully Funded PhD Position – Wearable Robotics | Spring 2027 🎉
 
I’m excited to recruit a second fully funded PhD student to join my research group at Kennesaw State University, with a planned start in spring 2027.
 
Our lab works on wearable and assistive robotic systems, with a focus on problems that connect control, hardware, sensing, and human–robot interaction. Much of our research involves designing, building, and testing real systems—including wearable robots, actuators, and sensor-based platforms—supported by modeling and simulation.
 
I welcome students from a variety of backgrounds. Applicants do not need experience in every area typically listed in a robotics position. What matters most is a strong technical foundation, curiosity, and an interest in developing expertise in one or more areas, such as
 
• Modeling and simulation
• Learning-based methods
• Control and robotics
• Hardware design and experimental testing
• Human–robot interaction
 
This position may be a good fit for students who enjoy hands-on system development and want to understand robotic system behavior through modeling, simulation, and experiments.
 
👏 Feel free to reach out if your background and research interests align with our work.

How to apply: If you are interested in this, please send your CV, research statement (describe why you fit this position and your motivation), transcripts, and publications to szhang23@kennesaw.edu. If you have a short video demo, website, or other materials showcasing your project experience or hands-on skills, feel free to include them—they are helpful but not required.
chinese_translation:
🎉 全额资助博士职位 – 可穿戴机器人 | 2027年春季 🎉
 
我很高兴招募第二名全额资助博士生加入我在肯内索州立大学的研究小组，计划于2027年春季开始。
 
我们的实验室致力于可穿戴和辅助机器人系统，重点解决连接控制、硬件、传感与人机交互的问题。我们的研究大多涉及设计、构建和测试真实系统——包括可穿戴机器人、执行器和基于传感器的平台——并由建模和仿真支持。
 
我欢迎来自各种背景的学生。申请人无需具备机器人职位通常列出的所有领域经验。最重要的是坚实的技术基础、好奇心，以及在一个或多个领域发展专长的兴趣，例如
 
• 建模与仿真
• 基于学习的方法
• 控制与机器人
• 硬件设计与实验测试
• 人机交互
 
此职位适合喜欢动手系统开发并通过建模、仿真和实验理解机器人系统行为的学生。
 
👏 如果您的背景和研究兴趣与我们的工作相符，请随时联系。

如何申请：如果您感兴趣，请将简历、研究声明（描述为何适合此职位及动机）、成绩单和出版物发送至 szhang23@kennesaw.edu。如果有展示项目经验或动手技能的短视频演示、网站或其他材料，欢迎附上——有帮助但非必需。
application_notes: Start Spring 2027; Email CV etc. to szhang23@kennesaw.edu
